purpose: Teach: カマ/ぽん/はいっ/よれ/たがら/辰/くろ/うぅ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんちにカマがあったの、見たよ
lines.en: Sho, I saw there was a kiln at Grandma's house.
lines.style: Gentle, observant tone. Warm curiosity — noticing something small and wondering if it mattered to him. Patient pacing, like she's inviting him to share if he wants to.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに、お背中をぽんと叩かれた
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad patted me on the back like this.
lines.style: Bright, eager energy. Quick words tumbling out. Pride mixed with the simple joy of sharing something that happened. Light, unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達がはいってきたわよ
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact announcement. A gentle lift in her voice — no fuss, but noticing he might want to know. Present and attentive.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくの体操服、よれちゃったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my gym clothes got all wrinkled.
lines.style: Small, self-aware complaint with a hint of wry humor underneath. Not actually upset — just noticing and reporting. Dry, understated.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お野菜、食べたがらないでね
lines.en: Sho, don't refuse to eat your vegetables, okay?
lines.style: Gentle directive, not stern. Warm but clear — the voice of someone who's been given responsibility and takes it seriously. Slight softness at the end, reassuring rather than commanding.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、辰年生まれだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I was born in the Year of the Dragon.
lines.style: Proud announcement, bright and earnest. He's sharing something he thinks is important about himself. Open, unguarded enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのくろいスーツ、お洒落ね
lines.en: Sho, your Dad's black suit looks so smart.
lines.style: Warm admiration, genuine notice. Soft, approving tone — not flattering, just observing something true. Tender attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、うぅ、ぼく、お腹空いた
lines.style: Small, needy sound at the start. Quiet complaint with underlying weariness — not dramatic, just stating a fact. Trailing-off suggestion of vulnerability.
